coverage_assessment: Thirty-six bilingual open-web searches across weekly, local, sectoral, regional, boundary and international sources. The IACHR report dates cited protest articles to April/May; a May 28 EFE result describes about ten participants but is search-only and outside the month. The cited Despacho 505 URL was not located in follow-up search. Havana Times’ Metrocentro action is coordinator-verified as Dec. 12, 2019. The separate Divergentes family-protest lead remains undated and lacks turnout. No January candidate or absence conclusion; baseline gate remains pending.
